refresh-interval.tooltip: How often the applet refreshes usage data.

opencode-data-dir.tooltip: The directory where OpenCode stores its credentials (opencode.db / auth.json). Leave empty to auto-detect ~/.local/share/opencode, then apply the value with the button below.

set-data-dir-button.tooltip: Use this OpenCode data directory. The meter's helper stores it; the applet itself never reads credentials.

clear-data-dir-button.tooltip: Clear the stored OpenCode data directory and go back to auto-detection.

set-api-key-button.tooltip: Store a fallback API key, used only while no local OpenCode login is available. The key is verified with OpenCode and never stored in the applet settings.

clear-api-key-button.tooltip: Remove the stored fallback API key.
